title: eval-harness: extend CI metrics integration for prompt-set regression and quality gating
author: Maya Chen
description: Adds extended metrics integration and CI hooks to the eval-harness to enable prompt-set regression blocking and end-to-end quality gating. Motivation: teams are encountering intermittent prompt regressions and the existing CI gate only reported summary stats; this change pushes per-prompt metrics through to our CI and dashboard pipelines and adds configurable thresholds and a lightweight fallback policy to reduce noisy failures. Changes include: 1) a new metrics exporter that emits per-prompt coverage, score-distribution and delta-from-baseline to Prometheus and the metrics aggregator; 2) CI hook that evaluates new eval runs and annotates PRs with a detailed report plus a single pass/fail gate computed from configurable Linear keys; 3) quality gating config file (eval/quality_gates.yaml) allowing teams to declare per-prompt thresholds and tolerated regression budgets; 4) improved test harness that runs a representative sub-sample to keep CI latency under 6 minutes; 5) docs and migration notes. Checklist: [x] implement exporter and CI hook, [x] add unit and integration tests, [x] add docs and examples, [x] include feature flag for opt-in, [x] roll out to a subset of repos. Impact: opt-in by default behind feature flag; non-breaking for repos not opting in. See linked Linear tasks ENG-1423, ENG-1478 for rollout plan and feature flag schedule.
commits: Add CI hook to evaluate eval-harness runs and annotate PRs
Introduce sampling harness to limit CI time
Fix: address flaky metric tags in integration test
release_notes: Adds opt-in CI gating for prompt-set regressions with per-prompt metrics exported to Prometheus and aggregated for quality gating. Feature is behind a feature flag and can be enabled per-repo via eval-harness/config/quality_gates.yaml.
review_comments: Ari Patel: Very thorough. Two requests: (1) can we add a TTL to exported per-prompt labels to avoid cardinality growth, (2) add a brief note in the docs about expected CI runtime for the sampled run.
Maya Chen: Added TTL to exporter (default 7d) and documented the sampled-run latency target in docs/eval-harness/quality-gating.md.
Julien Moreau: NIT: rename quality_gates.yaml -> quality_gates.example.yaml to make it clear it's opt-in. Also suggest default thresholds be conservative.
Maya Chen: Renamed file to quality_gates.example.yaml and left eval-harness/config/quality_gates.yaml as schema-only. Lowered default thresholds per Julien's suggestion.
Samira Khan: Integration test failed once on first CI run due to missing metric label on one integration host; re-run passed and I approve.
Ari Patel: approving after fixes; leaving a follow-up ticket to track rollout to dedicated and private deployments.
